features: 46.4 mm (1.83 inch) HD Display – Big, clear screen for easy viewing.
Bluetooth Calling – Answer and make calls right from your wrist.
120+ Sports Modes – Track a wide range of workouts.
AI Voice Assistant – Control tasks hands-free with voice commands.
Health Monitoring – Real-time heart rate and SpO2 tracking.
Smart Notifications – Alerts for calls, messages, and apps.
Long Battery Life – Up to ~7 days on a single charge.
IP67 Water Resistance – Ready for splashes, sweat, and everyday use.
Music & Camera Control – Manage music and snap photos from your wrist.
